Comment: Fetches a 500-record nested JSON dataset, loads it into DuckDB and aggregates salary statistics per region.

FetchRecords.Comment: GET /api/fake/json/records?count=500&seed=42 - nested records with tags, address and orders.

AggregateByRegion.Comment: Loads $.records into DuckDB table 'employees' and groups salary stats by region.

Parameters.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS employees, ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY region ORDER BY avg_salary DESC

ValidateAggregate.Comment: All four regions must be present in the aggregate result.

ValidationFailed.Cause: Expected at least 4 regions in the aggregate result
